# Critique reports

Output of the experimental critique pass (`kb/instructions/critique-note.md`): an on-demand, divergent review that builds the strongest case against a note's central commitment and checks whether the note already answers it.

Reports here are **gitignored** — they are regenerable working artifacts, read once and acted on, like connect reports. Only this README is tracked.

If a critique becomes durable standing context, move that report to
`kb/reports/retained/`; changing policy is explicit in the path rather than an
exception hidden in `.gitignore`.
